_comment: Copy the keys below into your own config. Do not commit real secrets. In development, set the connection string via `dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:Jayraj_Industries" "<value>"`. In production, set it via the ConnectionStrings__Jayraj_Industries environment variable (double underscore is ASP.NET Core's config section-nesting convention) — e.g. an IIS Application Pool environment variable, or web.config's <environmentVariables> for an IIS-hosted app.
